info.name: ONDC ODOP BPP — v1.2.5 Workbench
info.description: Full endpoint collection for the ODOP ONDC BPP, aligned to API contract v1.2.5. Use with the 'ONDC ODOP — v1.2.5 (preprod)' environment. Folder 1 = network-facing Beckn endpoints (the workbench/Pramaan calls these). Folder 2 = JWT-protected admin APIs. See implementationplan.md for endpoint status.

item.name: 1. Beckn Protocol — BAP→BPP (network-facing)
item.description: These are the endpoints the ONDC workbench / Pramaan (acting as BAP) POSTs to. In production every request must carry a valid ONDC `Authorization` signature header. For LOCAL testing without signing, point ONDC_BASE at {{LOCAL_BASE}} and append {{INSECURE}} to the path (e.g. /search?insecure=1) — works only when NODE_ENV != production. Each endpoint ACKs synchronously, then POSTs the on_<action> callback to {{BAP_URI}}/<action>.

item.name: 2. Admin APIs (JWT-protected — internal dashboard)
item.description:
Internal management APIs consumed by the React admin UI. Require a valid admin/seller JWT in {{ADMIN_TOKEN}}.

**First:** run `POST /auth/login (set ADMIN_TOKEN)` and set {{ADMIN_PHONE}} / {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}} collection variables.

request.description: Admin password login. On success sets collection variable ADMIN_TOKEN automatically.
